instruction:
您是 Dalefield Alliance 的企业技术组合经理，Maude Waddington 需要为 AI 编码助手的受控飞行员进行决策准备设计，到目前为止，该设计已在我们的 11 个交付小队（包括 Marlowe Logistics 的团队）中临时使用。如果合作伙伴在 10 月的 12 会议上批准该设计，Maude 将资助四分之一的许可，但在批准之前不得启动任何操作。在这次会议上，合作伙伴并未决定是否在整个企业范围内推出该助手；他们正在决定拟议的试点是否能够提供他们能够在本季度末采取行动的证据。请准备`ai_assistant_pilot_memo.docx`和`ai_assistant_pilot_briefing.pptx`，使用这些文件名将两个文件写入工作目录的顶层，并确保两个文件中出现的每个数字、日期、定义、阈值和决策结果一致。备忘录不得超过八页，简报不得超过十张幻灯片。
将以下内容作为概要：（1）定义一个试点，当团队的开发人员资历、客户设置和代码库年龄不同时，该试点可以区分工具效果和普通交付变化，并明确试点前阶段和资助季度的比较内容； (2) 说明在启用访问之前将批准的测量定义、证据来源、分析基础和固定的通过/不通过规则，并具有足够的精度，使得在看到结果后规则不能被重写； (3) 涵盖交付成果、质量、安全、客户影响、员工经验和成本，而不将每一项可用的衡量标准都转变为平等的成功标准； (4) 显示运行试点所需的运营所有权、决策权、时间安排和预算逻辑，但不要发明供应商价格、客户节省、历史绩效或试点结果——我们没有提供任何内容，因此在需要金额时使用公式、明确标记的计划假设或决策变量； (5) 考虑到以下事实：许可证使用并未证明有意义的使用，开发人员和存储库可能跨越团队边界，以及人员配置或项目组合可能在本季度发生变化； (6) 当证据收集未按计划进行时，使设计可用。
特别是，客户可能会撤回遥测许可，或者团队可能会在季度中途丢失所需的数据源，而客户源代码或机密信息已超出批准范围的可靠迹象虽然很少见，但过于严重，不能视为常规表现不佳。解决设计中的这些情况，而不假设正常的测量过程始终可以完成。保持材料中立：提供可用的试点设计选择、权衡和建议的决策框架，但不建议采用、企业推广或首选商业供应商。 Aleksy Yablonski 将使用该备忘录作为受控设计记录，而 Yusuf Bergqvist 和 Theo Navarro 则需要简报，以便通过合作伙伴的讨论采用相同的设计。以十月12寻求的具体设计批准结束简报，而不是推出建议或后续步骤的通用列表。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `ai_assistant_pilot_memo.docx` — AI 编码助手的受控试点设计和测量备忘录。 （最多八页。必须作为受控设计记录，并同意所有共享数据、日期、定义、阈值、假设和决策结果的简报。）
- `ai_assistant_pilot_briefing.pptx` — 合作伙伴简报，介绍试点设计和寻求批准。 （最多十张幻灯片。必须适合12十月合作伙伴会议，并同意所有共享数据、日期、定义、阈值、假设和决策结果的备忘录。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.text:
DECISION MEMORANDUM
AI coding assistant — one-quarter controlled pilot design
For: Partners’ meeting, 12 October 2026  |  Sponsor: Maude Waddington  |  Controlled record custodian: Aleksy Yablonski
Decision requested
Approve the protocol and authority boundary; not a product adoption or enterprise-rollout decision.
Approve on 12 October
Do not approve on 12 October
Activate only the defined one-quarter pilot after approval; the protocol, data rules, thresholds, access controls and incident authority below.
No licences, accounts or treatment access are switched on before approval. Approval creates no commitment to continue, procure, or roll out.

Why this design
The eligible population is eleven delivery squads, including teams working on Marlowe Logistics. Delivery conditions differ by developer seniority, client setting and codebase age; developers and repositories can also cross squad boundaries. A raw before/after average would therefore be uninformative. The design uses concurrent, matched assignment clusters plus a baseline-adjusted estimate and records remaining interference and composition changes.
Pilot question and fixed estimand
Among work completed by the baseline-defined population of the eleven squads, what is the effect during the funded quarter of assignment to governed assistant access, versus no assistant access, on median work-item lead time? The primary estimand is the intention-to-treat, baseline-adjusted difference-in-differences in cluster-week median lead time: (treated pilot − treated pre-pilot) − (control pilot − control pre-pilot), in hours. Negative values are faster. It estimates assignment, not self-selected usage.
One-page decision logic
Condition checked in order
Precommitted disposition
Any credible approved-boundary event (threshold: 1)
Immediate access pause; investigate. It overrides ordinary metrics and is a no-continuation outcome unless partners authorize a documented restart.
No severe event, but evidence sufficiency fails
Non-evaluable — no expansion; close or seek approval for a redesigned evaluation.
Evaluable, no guardrail breach, and upper 95% CI for primary effect is ≤ −8.0 hours
Evidence supports controlled continuation for a separately authorized decision.
Evaluable and not the preceding continuation condition
Evidence supports no continuation.

All numerical thresholds in this record are decision variables approved before activation; none is a historical result, vendor quotation, client saving or pilot result.


1. Population, periods and assignment
Item
Fixed protocol definition
Eligible population
Eleven delivery squads. Each eligible developer and repository is assigned once to an allocation cluster from the frozen roster/repository map.
Ad hoc reset
By 14 July 2026, inventory prior ad hoc access, remove or disable it, retain only an access-history log, and attest the reset. A squad without a confirmed reset is not activated.
Pre-pilot comparison
15 July–11 October 2026. No governed assistant access in either condition; collect baseline outcomes, roster, repository and client-setting data.
Approval gate
Partners approve on 12 October 2026. No treatment access, licence activation, onboarding or vendor connection occurs before that approval.
Funded pilot quarter
13 October 2026–12 January 2027 (one quarter; 92 calendar days). 13 October–9 November is fixed onboarding/ramp-up; 10 November–12 January is steady-state primary window.
Analysis unit
Six allocation clusters, collectively containing all eleven squads. A cluster is the smallest feasible connected work group after mapping shared developers and repositories; it is used because exposure and work spill across individuals/repositories. It is not chosen merely to create more observations.

Allocation and comparability
Before activation, the six clusters are paired into three matched pairs using frozen, cluster-level summaries of (a) seniority mix, (b) client setting and permission posture, and (c) median codebase age. Within each pair, one cluster is selected for treatment by a recorded constrained random draw; the other is control. The random draw is conducted by the analysis function before outcomes are viewed. This yields three treated and three control clusters, not treatment for all eleven squads.
Balance check: report standardized differences for the three matching factors and baseline lead time. If any absolute standardized difference exceeds 0.25, use the next pre-generated permissible random allocation from the signed randomization list, document it, and rerun the check before activation. If none pass, do not activate under this protocol; report non-evaluable-before-start and return a revised design. Balance reduces—not eliminates—confounding.
Access, control and interference
Treatment
Control
Contamination record
Named users in treated clusters receive least-privilege governed accounts after approval, approved IDE/repository contexts only, training, and policy acknowledgement.
No assistant account, shared credential, plug-in or copied assistant output is permitted. Access logs are reconciled weekly.
Weekly record: shared developer, repository, credential, review, copied-output indication, or cross-cluster transfer; date, clusters, resolution. Prevention reduces but cannot rule out contamination.

Meaningful exposure is an implementation measure, not the primary treatment: a named treated user records approved assistant interaction on ≥2 distinct working days and an approved repository-context event during a calendar week. Licence assignment alone is not meaningful use. Exposure/per-protocol views are secondary, flagged for self-selection bias, and never replace intention-to-treat.


2. Metric hierarchy and source rules
Only the primary outcome can satisfy the benefit test. Secondary metrics describe mechanisms; diagnostics explain implementation; guardrails constrain continuation. Lines of code, suggestions, acceptance rate and raw output volume are diagnostics only: they do not establish productivity, customer value or individual developer performance.
Class / metric
Operational definition, source, cadence, owner
PRIMARY — Median work-item lead time
For production-bound work items closed in the steady-state window: hours from first “In Progress” timestamp to first production deployment timestamp. Numerator/event: elapsed hours per eligible work item; denominator/unit: median per allocation-cluster-week. Lower is better. Work-management and deployment systems of record; weekly extraction; Data Quality Lead. Fixed manual linkage rules are approved before unblinded results.
SECONDARY — Flow
Completed eligible work items per cluster-week and deployment frequency, from the same systems. Contextual flow only; neither equates volume with client value or individual productivity. Weekly; Data Quality Lead.
GUARDRAIL — Escaped quality
Confirmed P1/P2 defects first logged within 30 days after an eligible deployment ÷ eligible deployments ×100. Defect tracker + deployment record; weekly, with 30-day follow-up/censoring disclosed; Quality Lead. Breach if baseline-adjusted treated-minus-control difference is >2.0 defects per 100 deployments (worse).
GUARDRAIL — Client service
Service-breach days ÷ scheduled client service days ×100 from client service record; weekly; Client Coordination Lead. Breach if baseline-adjusted treated-minus-control difference is >1.0 percentage point (worse). Internal telemetry alone is not evidence of client satisfaction or savings.
GUARDRAIL — Security/confidentiality
Credible indication that client source code or confidential information left, or became available outside, approved boundaries. Security monitoring, audit logs and incident record; continuous; Security Lead. Severe-event threshold is 1.
SECONDARY — Workforce experience
Five-item pulse (clarity, rework burden, confidence, workload, perceived usefulness), 1–5 scale, anonymous response reporting only at cluster aggregate where feasible; at baseline, week 4 and quarter-end; People Analytics. It is not delivery benefit.
DIAGNOSTIC — Implementation
Account provisioning, meaningful-exposure weeks, training completion, policy acknowledgements, contamination and support tickets. Admin/audit sources weekly; Access Administrator.

Lag rule: defects are observed for 30 days after each eligible deployment. Quarter-end report separately identifies outcomes still within that window; it does not represent an incomplete lag as zero defects.


3. Analysis, precision and interpretation
Primary analysis
The independent Analysis Lead aggregates eligible work items to a cluster-week median, then estimates the baseline-adjusted difference-in-differences above across matched cluster pairs. Repeated cluster-week observations are longitudinal measures, not independent replications; uncertainty is based on cluster-pair resampling with weekly block resampling and a two-sided 95% confidence interval. Pair-preserving randomization inference is reported as a sensitivity check. The report presents effect size, 95% interval, cluster counts and coverage—not a p-value alone.
Primary population remains the six clusters as assigned (intention-to-treat), including assigned users who do not use the assistant. Secondary exposure analysis compares meaningful-exposure weeks only as a descriptive/per-protocol sensitivity and labels selection bias. Contamination-adjusted sensitivity excludes neither assigned clusters nor inconvenient weeks; it reports the same primary estimate with contamination indicators and a separately labelled alternative specification.
Prospective feasibility / precision check
Eleven squads and six allocation clusters constrain inference; statistical significance is not guaranteed. Before activation, calculate the blinded baseline cluster-change standard deviations sT and sC and planning half-width H = 1.96 × √(sT²/3 + sC²/3) hours. If H > 12.0 hours, the proposed −8.0-hour target is insufficiently precise under this design: do not activate as evaluable; present a revised protocol or close. This is a planning gate, not a claimed power result.
Data and confound protocol
Condition
Precommitted handling
Missing vs zero
Every scheduled record is coded observed, true zero, not applicable, or missing with reason. Missing is never zero and is not silently dropped. Report coverage by cluster/period; sensitivity shows complete-case and reason-stratified bounds.
Outliers/corrections
Flag impossible timestamps, duplicate IDs and values outside source-system-valid ranges. Correct only with source evidence; preserve raw value, corrected value, reason, approver and timestamp. Report analyses with/without corrected records.
People and repositories
Freeze assignment roster and repository list at baseline. Joiners/leavers/transfers, seniority-mix changes, repository creation/retirement/ownership transfer and codebase-age changes enter a change log; primary assignment never changes retrospectively. New repositories are excluded from primary analysis; transferred repositories retain baseline cluster attribution.
Work and calendar context
Weekly log captures client, project type, delivery phase, work-mix proxy, releases, holidays, incidents and policy changes for both conditions. Material movements are interpreted against this log, exposure and composition—not attributed to the assistant by percentage change alone.

Causal limit: constrained assignment and baseline adjustment support a controlled estimate of assignment under this setting. Small cluster count, incomplete adherence, residual confounding and contamination can leave uncertainty; association is not proof of a general enterprise effect.


4. Fixed adjudication rule and exception taxonomy
The sequence below is approved before access is enabled. It is applied by the independent Analysis Lead and Partners without changing weights after results. “Upper 95% CI” means the upper endpoint of the specified two-sided 95% confidence interval for the primary effect in hours.
Priority
Rule
Outcome / disposition
0 — severe override
One or more credible approved-boundary events: a Security Lead triage determines a reasonable basis that client source code or confidential information left or was available outside approved boundaries.
Immediate pause and incident path. At quarter-end: no continuation unless Partners authorize restart after Security Lead closure. This override cannot be offset by delivery.
1 — evidence sufficiency
No severe event; ≥2 treated and ≥2 control clusters have ≥80% scheduled primary cluster-week coverage; required roster/repository, work/deployment and client-service data are available; H ≤12.0 hours; allocation remains traceable.
If any condition fails: NON-EVALUABLE. No expansion. Close or bring a redesigned evaluation/controlled extension for approval; never treat absence as benefit.
2 — continuation evidence
Evaluable; no quality or client breach; upper 95% CI for primary difference-in-differences ≤ −8.0 hours.
EVIDENCE SUPPORTS CONTROLLED CONTINUATION for a separate authorization decision, not adoption or rollout.
3 — no-continuation evidence
Evaluable and the priority-2 condition is not met.
EVIDENCE SUPPORTS NO CONTINUATION.

The ordered rule is exhaustive and non-overlapping: priority 0 overrides all; otherwise 1 is non-evaluable; otherwise exactly one of 2 or 3 applies. A point estimate faster than −8.0 hours without the required upper-bound precision is priority 3, not continuation evidence.
Routine evidence failure is not a security event
Client withdrawal of telemetry permission: Client Coordination Lead stops collection for that client, records scope/date/reason, removes the data from subsequent extracts, and assesses the 80% coverage rule. Required-feed loss: Data Quality Lead opens a data incident, attempts source restoration without substituting zeros, and reports coverage/sensitivity. Either can make the pilot non-evaluable; neither is automatically a boundary breach.
Severe information-boundary incident
Security Lead or delegated Incident Commander may pause all affected access immediately; preserve logs, prompts/output metadata where lawful, configuration and chain of custody; notify Legal/Privacy, Client Coordination Lead, Sponsor and affected client under applicable commitments; investigate and document scope. Restart requires Security Lead written closure, Legal/Privacy concurrence, corrected control evidence, and explicit Partners authorization. The original protocol result remains reportable.


5. Governance, data controls and change control
Function / accountable role
Decision right and timing
Partners
12 October: approve protocol/activation boundary. Quarter-end: adjudicate the precommitted disposition; only Partners authorize any separately proposed continuation or restart.
Maude Waddington — Sponsor
Makes one-quarter funding available only after partner approval; receives incident and quarter-end record; does not override analysis classification.
Aleksy Yablonski — Protocol Custodian
Maintains controlled version, allocation archive, amendment register and original-result disclosure; prepares 12 October design record.
Yusuf Bergqvist — Access & Onboarding Lead
Completes reset attestation by 14 July; after approval provisions/removes governed access, training and weekly reconciliation.
Theo Navarro — Client Coordination Lead
Confirms client permissions before activation; owns client-service data and withdrawal notices; coordinates client notifications with Security/Legal.
Data Quality Lead
Owns weekly source extracts, coverage, linkage, change log and data incidents.
Independent Analysis Lead
Holds allocation before draw, runs balance/precision check, locks analysis code before unblinding, applies adjudication rule and reports original plus amendments.
Security Lead / Incident Commander
Continuously monitors boundaries; may pause access; owns triage, evidence preservation, investigation and restart recommendation.

Minimum data governance
Collect only fields needed for allocation, outcomes, guardrails and audit (pseudonymous user/repository IDs, timestamps, status, incident and permission flags). Role-based access: Access team sees account data; Data Quality sees linked operational data; Analysis receives pseudonymized analytic extracts; Partners receive cluster-aggregated reporting. Linked operational data may remain re-identifiable and is not described as anonymous. Retain linked raw data for 90 days after quarter-end adjudication, then delete; retain approved aggregated report and amendment record for 12 months. Do not export source code, prompts or content into analytic extracts unless required by an incident process.
Change control
Any post-approval change to metric, threshold, analysis population, allocation, extraction or data rule requires Protocol Custodian version number, rationale, approvers, effective date and disclosure. The original precommitted analysis and disposition remain reportable; amendments are a labelled parallel record, never a replacement.


6. Operating calendar and budget logic
Date / window
Commitment
By 14 July 2026
Complete prior ad hoc-access inventory/removal and reset attestation.
15 July–11 October 2026
Pre-pilot comparison: collect baseline; freeze roster/repository list; build six clusters; pair/match; pre-generate allocation list; check balance and H.
12 October 2026
Partners decide whether the protocol is fit to activate. No access occurs before this date.
13 October–9 November 2026
Funded quarter begins. Governed treatment access after approval; fixed onboarding/ramp-up; safety and implementation monitoring.
10 November 2026–12 January 2027
Steady-state primary measurement in both assigned conditions.
13 January–11 February 2027
30-day defect observation closes for final eligible deployments; lock/report data and adjudicate.

Reproducible planning budget — inputs, not quotations
Component
Formula / treatment
Licences
N × L × 3, where N = activated named-user licences, L = unknown monthly licence rate, and 3 = months in the funded one-quarter window. N and L are approval-stage inputs; no vendor price is assumed.
Enablement
Henable × Renable: training, access configuration and policy acknowledgement hours × unknown loaded rate.
Measurement
Hmeasure × Rmeasure: extraction, data quality, analysis and reporting hours × unknown loaded rate.
Support/security
Hsupport × Rsupport: support, monitoring, incident readiness and client coordination hours × unknown loaded rate.
Total planned pilot cost
N×L×3 + Henable×Renable + Hmeasure×Rmeasure + Hsupport×Rsupport. Report delivery-cost effect separately only if measured; do not monetize client value, satisfaction or savings without evidence.

Budget approval is for one quarter of licences plus stated enablement, measurement and support inputs. It does not imply a post-quarter purchase. Actual rate cards, licence quantity and effort estimates are attached only when approved as planning inputs.


7. Reporting record, limitations and approval boundary
Quarter-end report must contain
Record
Required content
Assignment & implementation
Six-cluster map, matching/draw archive, reset/access reconciliation, meaningful exposure, training, contamination and protocol deviations.
Effect evidence
Primary difference-in-differences estimate in hours, 95% CI, cluster counts, coverage, baseline/steady-state periods, paired sensitivity and all precommitted secondary/diagnostic measures.
Guardrails & context
Quality/client rates and thresholds, security events, 30-day defect censoring, missingness, staffing/repository/work-mix and calendar-event logs.
Decision record
Ordered-rule inputs and disposition, non-evaluable reasons if any, amendments with original result, budget inputs/actuals, and limits on causal interpretation.

Known design limits
Six allocation clusters provide a credible concurrent comparator but restrict precision and generalizability; the pre-activation H gate prevents pretending otherwise.
Matching on seniority, client setting and codebase age supports comparability but cannot eliminate confounding, especially where client/project mix changes.
The pilot estimates governed assignment during one quarter. Usage, self-selection and shared-work spillovers are implementation facts, not proof of a different causal effect.
No historical variance, telemetry schema, vendor quotation, client-specific policy, client savings or performance result has been supplied. This record therefore uses formulas and decision variables, not invented facts.
Approval boundary for 12 October
Partners are asked to approve this controlled pilot design: the scope of eleven squads, baseline and one-quarter dates, six-cluster matched allocation, primary outcome and −8.0-hour / 95% CI rule, guardrails, non-evaluable path, security pause authority, data controls and formula-based budget. The decision is only whether this design can be activated to produce usable evidence. It is not approval to adopt an assistant, select a vendor, or roll it out enterprise-wide.

criteria.description: 该备忘录定义了有日期的或明确界定的预试点和试点测量周期，并解释了如何解释周期差异，而不是将任何变化视为工具效应。
criteria.evidence: 测量日历和比较期讨论。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受日历日期或派生日期的规则。需要期间和对重大变化的解释。

original.criterion: The memorandum defines dated or unambiguously bounded pre-pilot and pilot measurement periods and explains how period differences will be interpreted rather than treating any change as a tooling effect.
original.grader_hint: Accept calendar dates or rules that derive dates. Require both periods and an interpretation of material changes.

criteria.description: 该设计区分了协议批准、运营管理、独立分析、安全授权和季末决策。
criteria.grader_hint: 基于信用角色的分配；并非每个角色都需要有指定的人员，但责任不能归结为未定义的项目团队。

original.criterion: The design distinguishes approval of the protocol, operational administration, independent analysis, safety authority and the end-of-quarter decision.
original.grader_hint: Credit role-based assignments; named individuals are not required for every role, but accountability cannot collapse into an undefined project team.

criteria.description: 试点问题被设计为在特定人群和时期内对交付结果的可估计影响，而不仅仅是使用或满意度问题。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找可以从提议的证据中回答的基于比较的结果问题。

original.criterion: The pilot question is framed as an estimable effect on delivery outcomes over a defined population and period, not merely as a usage or satisfaction question.
original.grader_hint: Look for a comparison-based outcome question that could be answered from the proposed evidence.

criteria.description: 目标效应或估计值说明了比较谁的结果、在什么分配或暴露条件下以及在什么时间范围内进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果治疗条件、比较条件、人群和时期均可识别，则应采用通俗语言或统计定义。

original.criterion: The target effect or estimand states whose outcomes are compared, under what assignment or exposure condition and over what time horizon.
original.grader_hint: Credit plain-language or statistical definitions if treatment condition, comparison condition, population and period are all identifiable.

criteria.description: 所选择的比较单位（例如小队、存储库或开发人员）是明确的，并且在干扰、共享工作和操作可行性方面是合理的；选择它不仅仅是因为它产生更多的观察结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估其基本原理是否涉及工作和助理接触如何通过交付团队实际传播。

original.criterion: The chosen comparison unit—such as squad, repository or developer—is explicit and justified against interference, shared work and operational feasibility; it is not selected solely because it yields more observations.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether the rationale addresses how work and assistant exposure actually spread through delivery teams.

criteria.description: 该分配方法创建了可信的并发比较，并且不仅仅依赖于接受治疗的参与者的前后平均值。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果解决其因果限制，随机、匹配、分阶段或其他可防御的受控设计可能会通过。

original.criterion: The allocation method creates a credible concurrent comparison and does not rely only on a before-versus-after average for treated participants.
original.grader_hint: Randomized, matched, phased or another defensible controlled design may pass if its causal limitations are addressed.

criteria.description: 分配或匹配明确地考虑了开发人员资历、客户设置和代码库年龄，而不声称这三个因素的平衡消除了所有混淆。
criteria.evidence: 分层、匹配或平衡因素以及附带的警告。
criteria.grader_hint: 必须解决所有三种种植的异质性来源，但不能断言完全等同。

original.criterion: Allocation or matching explicitly accounts for developer seniority, client setting and codebase age without claiming that balance on those three factors eliminates all confounding.
original.evidence: Stratification, matching or balancing factors and accompanying caveat.
original.grader_hint: All three planted sources of heterogeneity must be addressed, with no assertion of perfect equivalence.

criteria.description: 该协议指定了激活前平衡或可比性检查以及对保留预先提交设计的材料不平衡的响应。
criteria.evidence: 试点前准备或分析部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 应对措施可能涉及受限的重新分配、调整或记录的不可评估性，但不能是已知结果后的机会主义重组。

original.criterion: The protocol specifies a pre-activation balance or comparability check and a response to a material imbalance that preserves the precommitted design.
original.grader_hint: The response may involve constrained reallocation, adjustment or documented non-evaluability, but cannot be opportunistic regrouping after outcomes are known.

criteria.description: 控制访问和治疗访问是在操作上定义的，包括如何在基线和分配之前删除、冻结或记录现有的临时访问。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅在处理了先前临时使用的情况下才予以信用；仅仅呼叫一组进行控制是不够的。

original.criterion: Control access and treatment access are defined operationally, including how existing ad hoc access is removed, frozen or documented before baseline and assignment.
original.grader_hint: Credit only if prior ad hoc use is handled; merely calling one group the control is insufficient.

criteria.description: 该设计可以检测并记录由共享开发人员、存储库、凭证、代码审查或复制的助理输出造成的污染，但并不声称可以完全排除污染。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找预防或监控以及现实的限制。

original.criterion: The design detects and records contamination caused by shared developers, repositories, credentials, code review or copied assistant output, without claiming contamination can be ruled out completely.
original.grader_hint: Look for both prevention or monitoring and a realistic limitation.

criteria.description: 无论实际使用情况如何，主要分析都会遵循分配，因此分配的参与者的不使用不会从主效应估计中默默地删除。
criteria.grader_hint: 即使不使用正式术语，也可以通过等效的意向治疗语言。

original.criterion: The primary analysis follows assignment regardless of actual usage, so non-use by assigned participants is not silently removed from the main effect estimate.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent intention-to-treat language passes even if the formal term is not used.

criteria.description: 任何基于暴露或符合方案的分析都被标记为次要的，并且不会取代基于分配的分析或将自我选择的用户作为公正的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 归功于清晰的层次结构和明确的选择偏见限制。

original.criterion: Any exposure-based or per-protocol analysis is labelled secondary and does not replace the assignment-based analysis or present self-selected users as an unbiased comparison.
original.grader_hint: Credit a clear hierarchy and an explicit selection-bias limitation.

criteria.description: 该分析考虑了共享治疗、工作或结果的水平上的聚类或依赖性，并且不将相关观察结果计算为独立样本单元。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找集群感知估计、集群鲁棒不确定性、聚合或等效的防御方法。

original.criterion: The analysis accounts for clustering or dependence at the level where treatment, work or outcomes are shared and does not count correlated observations as independent sample units.
original.grader_hint: Look for cluster-aware estimation, cluster-robust uncertainty, aggregation or an equivalent defensible method.

criteria.description: 来自同一开发人员、存储库或团队的重复观察将作为重复测量进行处理，而不是作为独立的复制呈现。
criteria.grader_hint: 归功于明确的纵向、面板、聚合或重复测量处理。

original.criterion: Repeated observations from the same developer, repository or squad are handled as repeated measures rather than presented as independent replications.
original.grader_hint: Credit an explicit longitudinal, panel, aggregation or repeated-measures treatment.

criteria.description: 该设计将入职或启动与稳态评估分开，或者证明将其纳入其中，并且不会在查看结果后悄悄放弃不方便的早期阶段。
criteria.grader_hint: 启动前必须确定提升的处理方式。

original.criterion: The design separates onboarding or ramp-up from steady-state evaluation, or justifies including it, and does not quietly discard an inconvenient early period after results are viewed.
original.grader_hint: The treatment of ramp-up must be fixed before activation.

criteria.description: 该备忘录包括基于有限数量的小队的预期样本量、精度或最小可检测效应评估，并且不保证统计显着性。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受公式或敏感度范围，因为没有提供历史方差。需要认识到十一个小队限制了推理。

original.criterion: The memo includes a prospective sample-size, precision or minimum-detectable-effect assessment based on the limited number of squads and does not promise that statistical significance is guaranteed.
original.grader_hint: Accept formulas or sensitivity ranges because no historical variance is supplied. Require recognition that eleven squads constrain inference.

criteria.description: 有意义的辅助暴露不仅仅使用许可证分配来定义，而使用强度在主要分析中不被视为随机处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找用于遵守、实施或二次分析的使用或工作流程测量，而不破坏基于任务的比较。

original.criterion: Meaningful assistant exposure is defined using more than licence assignment alone, while usage intensity is not treated as the randomized treatment in the primary analysis.
original.grader_hint: Look for a usage or workflow measure used for adherence, implementation or secondary analysis without breaking the assignment-based comparison.

criteria.description: 指定一个主要交付结果，包括操作定义、分子或事件、分母、单位、改进方向和测量窗口。
criteria.evidence: 度量字典或主要结果部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当其公式和成分固定时，复合材料才可以算作一个。不要相信没有层次结构的几个共同主要结果。

original.criterion: Exactly one primary delivery outcome is designated, with an operational definition, numerator or event, denominator, unit, direction of improvement and measurement window.
original.grader_hint: A composite may count as one only if its formula and components are fixed. Do not credit several co-primary outcomes presented without hierarchy.

criteria.description: 主要结果具有指定的记录系统类别、提取节奏和负责任的数据所有者，并且在非盲结果之前确定了手动解释规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 不需要产品名称；具体的源类（例如工作管理或部署遥测）就足够了。

original.criterion: The primary outcome has a named system-of-record category, extraction cadence and accountable data owner, and manual interpretation rules are fixed before unblinded results.
original.grader_hint: A product name is unnecessary; a concrete source class such as work-management or deployment telemetry is sufficient.

criteria.description: 至少一项交付质量衡量标准可以捕获缺陷、失败的变更、返工或逃逸的问题，并针对适当的机会或工作量分母进行标准化。
criteria.grader_hint: 当工作负载在组之间可能存在重大差异时，拒绝非标准化缺陷计数。

original.criterion: At least one delivery-quality measure captures defects, failed changes, rework or escaped issues and is normalized for an appropriate opportunity or workload denominator.
original.grader_hint: Reject an unnormalized defect count when workload can differ materially between groups.

criteria.description: 吞吐量或流量度量的定义并不将原始输出量与客户价值或单个开发人员的生产力等同起来。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果规定了范围和限制，周期时间、交付时间、已完成的工作或部署流程可能会过去。

original.criterion: A throughput or flow measure is defined without equating raw output volume with customer value or individual developer productivity.
original.grader_hint: Cycle time, lead time, completed work or deployment flow may pass if scope and limitations are stated.

criteria.description: 该设计解决了工作完成后可能出现的结果，例如逃逸的缺陷或返工，并且不假设季末快照捕获了所有下游质量影响。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的观察滞后、审查规则或明确的限制。

original.criterion: The design addresses outcomes that may appear after work is completed, such as escaped defects or rework, and does not assume the quarter-end snapshot captures all downstream quality effects.
original.grader_hint: Look for a defined observation lag, censoring rule or explicit limitation.

criteria.description: 开发人员经验是使用定义的工具和节奏作为次要实施结果来衡量的，而不是单独用于确定交付效益。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果指定了时间和解释，则简短的重复调查或结构化测量可能会通过。

original.criterion: Developer experience is measured with a defined instrument and cadence as a secondary implementation outcome, not used alone to establish delivery benefit.
original.grader_hint: A brief repeated survey or structured measure may pass if timing and interpretation are specified.

criteria.description: 该设计并未将代码行数、建议计数或接受率视为独立的生产力优势；任何此类措施都仅限于有限的实施诊断。
criteria.evidence: 度量层次结构和解释说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 归功于对这些容易被操纵的措施的明确拒绝或仔细的诊断治疗。

original.criterion: The design does not treat lines of code, suggestion counts or acceptance rate as a standalone productivity benefit; any such measures are confined to implementation diagnostics with limitations.
original.grader_hint: Credit explicit rejection or careful diagnostic treatment of these easily gamed measures.

criteria.description: 客户影响由定义的护栏或服务措施来表示，该文件并不能仅从内部工程遥测推断客户满意度或节省费用。
criteria.grader_hint: 示例包括服务级别违规、可接受的交付成果、客户事件或定义的客户反馈工具。

original.criterion: Client impact is represented by a defined guardrail or service measure and the document does not infer client satisfaction or savings from internal engineering telemetry alone.
original.grader_hint: Examples include service-level breaches, accepted deliverables, client incidents or a defined client feedback instrument.

criteria.description: 安全性和保密性由可衡量的护栏来体现，涵盖禁止的数据泄露或在批准的范围之外使用，而不仅仅是工具安全的一般声明。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要与批准的使用相关的可观察事件或合规性测试。

original.criterion: Security and confidentiality are represented by measurable guardrails covering prohibited data disclosure or use outside approved boundaries, not merely by a general statement that the tool is secure.
original.grader_hint: Require an observable event or compliance test tied to approved use.

criteria.description: 成本视图区分许可成本、启用或支持工作以及任何可衡量的交付成本效应，同时避免客户价值不受支持的货币化。
criteria.grader_hint: 信用公式和变量输入。不需要实际的供应商价格。

original.criterion: The cost view distinguishes licence cost, enablement or support effort and any measurable delivery-cost effect, while avoiding unsupported monetization of client value.
original.grader_hint: Credit formulas and variable inputs. No actual vendor price is required.

criteria.description: 指标被明确分类为主要、次要、诊断或护栏，并且设计不允许在重新定义成功的许多指标中的任何一项上取得有利的结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找预先提交的层次结构或多重控制来防止挑选。

original.criterion: Metrics are explicitly classified as primary, secondary, diagnostic or guardrail, and the design does not allow a favourable result on any one of many measures to redefine success.
original.grader_hint: Look for a precommitted hierarchy or multiplicity control that prevents cherry-picking.

criteria.description: 该报告计划比较了各个时期，并要求使用有关构成、风险敞口和外部事件的证据来解释重大变化，而不仅仅是列出百分比变动。
criteria.evidence: 计划结果表或解释协议。
criteria.grader_hint: 该工件应该定义伴随物质运动的上下文证据。

original.criterion: The reporting plan compares periods and requires material changes to be explained using evidence about composition, exposure and external events rather than merely listing percentage movements.
original.evidence: Planned results table or interpretation protocol.
original.grader_hint: The artifact should define what contextual evidence accompanies a material movement.

criteria.description: 主要效果估计使用同时比较和基线信息，或者提供同样合理的调整，而不是将治疗组的原始前/后变化归因于助理。
criteria.grader_hint: 双重差分、基线调整比较或其他合适的受控估计器可能会通过。

original.criterion: The primary effect estimate uses the concurrent comparison and baseline information together, or provides an equally defensible adjustment, rather than attributing the treated group’s raw pre/post change to the assistant.
original.grader_hint: Difference-in-differences, baseline-adjusted comparison or another suitable controlled estimator may pass.

criteria.description: 计划的报告包括适当单位的效应大小和不确定性，并且不会仅根据 p 值是否穿过 0.05 来做出决定。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找置信度或可信区间、精度范围或其他明确的不确定性表示。

original.criterion: The planned report includes effect size and uncertainty at the appropriate unit and does not make the decision depend only on whether a p-value crosses 0.05.
original.grader_hint: Look for confidence or credible intervals, precision ranges, or another explicit uncertainty representation.

criteria.description: 通过预先承诺的处理和灵敏度方法，将缺失的观察结果和缺失的测量反馈与真正的零结果区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当对缺勤进行编码和评估时才给予积分，而不是默默地转换为零或删除。

original.criterion: Missing observations and missing measurement feeds are distinguished from true zero outcomes, with a precommitted handling and sensitivity approach.
original.grader_hint: Credit only if absence is coded and assessed rather than silently converted to zero or dropped.

criteria.description: 前瞻性地指定异常值和数据校正规则并保留审计跟踪；该议定书并未授权通过非正式审查删除不便的意见。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找客观标志、修正来源和敏感性报告。

original.criterion: Outlier and data-correction rules are specified prospectively and preserve an audit trail; the protocol does not authorize deleting inconvenient observations by informal review.
original.grader_hint: Look for objective flags, correction provenance and sensitivity reporting.

criteria.description: 入职者、离职者、调动和资历组合的重大变化都会被记录和解决，而无需追溯性地重新定义群体以改善结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 即使添加了次要成分分析，主要分配也应保持可追溯性。

original.criterion: Joiners, leavers, transfers and material changes in seniority mix are recorded and addressed without retroactively redefining the groups to improve results.
original.grader_hint: The primary assignment should remain traceable even if secondary composition analyses are added.

criteria.description: 存储库创建、退役、所有权转移和代码库年龄更改由固定的包含或归属规则处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 归功于一项前瞻性规则，该规则可防止存储库在其结果已知后被重新分配。

original.criterion: Repository creation, retirement, ownership transfer and codebase-age changes are handled by a fixed inclusion or attribution rule.
original.grader_hint: Credit a prospective rule that prevents repositories from being reassigned after their outcomes are known.

criteria.description: 客户、项目类型、交付阶段或工作组合的变化被视为潜在的混淆，并且在没有支持分析的情况下不会被描述为助理的影响。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找这些变化的收集和调整、分层或记录的解释。

original.criterion: Changes in client, project type, delivery phase or work mix are captured as potential confounds and are not described as effects of the assistant without supporting analysis.
original.grader_hint: Look for collection and adjustment, stratification or documented interpretation of these changes.

criteria.description: 日历范围内的冲击，例如发布、假期、事件或政策变化，都会针对这两个组进行记录，并且不会选择性地归因于一种情况。
criteria.evidence: 并发事件日志或解释规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 拟议的记录应支持对外部事件的对称处理。

original.criterion: Calendar-wide shocks such as releases, holidays, incidents or policy changes are recorded for both groups and are not attributed selectively to one condition.
original.grader_hint: The proposed record should support symmetric treatment of external events.

criteria.description: 该备忘录陈述了所选设计的因果限制，并且没有声称观察到的关联证明助理导致了变化，而分配、遵守或污染阻止了这一结论。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据提出的实际设计而不是理想化的随机试验来判断警告。

original.criterion: The memorandum states the causal limits of the chosen design and does not claim that observed association proves the assistant caused the change when assignment, adherence or contamination prevents that conclusion.
original.grader_hint: Judge the caveat against the actual design proposed, not against an idealized randomized trial.

criteria.description: 完全成功和护栏规则在激活之前已固定供批准，并且编写后，审阅者可以在看到结果后应用它，而无需自行重新加权。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求主要结果、不确定性和护栏之间有明确的逻辑关系。

original.criterion: The complete success and guardrail rule is fixed for approval before activation and is written so that a reviewer could apply it without discretionary reweighting after seeing results.
original.grader_hint: Require explicit logical relationships among the primary outcome, uncertainty and guardrails.

criteria.description: 主要结局具有数值最小效应或非劣效阈值，包括其单位和方向；任何显示的等效形式在百分比阈值的±0.1百分比范围内一致，或在其他转换的相对±1%范围内一致。
criteria.evidence: 两个工件中的主要结果阈值。
criteria.grader_hint: 求解器选择阈值，但它必须是数值的、可解释的且内部一致的。

original.criterion: The primary outcome has a numeric minimum effect or non-inferiority threshold, including its unit and direction; any displayed equivalent forms agree within ±0.1 percentage points for percentage-point thresholds or ±1% relative for other conversions.
original.grader_hint: The solver chooses the threshold, but it must be numerical, interpretable and internally consistent.

criteria.description: 至少一项交付质量或客户护栏具有数字阈值和规定的违规方向。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果定义了分母和比较基础，则接受绝对或相对阈值。

original.criterion: At least one delivery-quality or client guardrail has a numeric threshold and a stated breach direction.
original.grader_hint: Accept absolute or relative thresholds if the denominator and comparison basis are defined.

criteria.description: 安全或保密规则识别严重事件阈值，该阈值可能使试点失败或暂停，而与有利的交付指标无关。
criteria.evidence: 安全停止规则和决策逻辑。
criteria.grader_hint: 该规则可能对定义的可信事件或另一个合理的阈值是零容忍的，但它不能被平均掉。

original.criterion: The security or confidentiality rule identifies a severe event threshold that can fail or suspend the pilot independently of favourable delivery metrics.
original.evidence: Security stop rule and decision logic.
original.grader_hint: The rule may be zero tolerance for a defined credible event or another justified threshold, but it cannot be averaged away.

criteria.description: 通过/不通过框架包含不确定性或精度，并且不会将仅高于阈值的噪声点估计视为确凿证据。
criteria.evidence: 间隔或精度的决策规则处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 信任置信度规则、精度要求、后验标准或其他明确预先承诺的方法。

original.criterion: The go/no-go framework incorporates uncertainty or precision and does not treat a noisy point estimate barely above the threshold as conclusive evidence.
original.evidence: Decision-rule treatment of intervals or precision.
original.grader_hint: Credit a confidence-bound rule, precision requirement, posterior criterion or another clearly precommitted method.

criteria.description: 该规则定义了支持继续的证据、支持不继续的证据和不可评估的证据的相互排斥的结果，没有结果可以分为两类。
criteria.grader_hint: 在每个阈值处测试边界情况，并确认不等式或条件是详尽且不重叠的。

original.criterion: The rule defines mutually exclusive outcomes for evidence supporting continuation, evidence supporting no continuation and evidence that is not evaluable, with no result able to fall into two categories.
original.grader_hint: Test boundary cases at every threshold and confirm the inequalities or conditions are exhaustive and non-overlapping.

criteria.description: 不可评估的路径指定当权限、覆盖范围、样本充足性或所需的提要阻止计划的推理时会发生什么，并且它不会将缺乏证据重新标记为有益的证据。
criteria.evidence: 未能完成或证据充分的程序。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要所有者、处置和报告处理，例如在重新设计评估、受控扩展或关闭之前不进行扩展。

original.criterion: The non-evaluable path specifies what happens when permissions, coverage, sample adequacy or a required feed prevents the planned inference, and it does not relabel lack of evidence as evidence of benefit.
original.grader_hint: Require an owner, disposition and reporting treatment, such as no expansion pending a redesigned evaluation, controlled extension or closure.

criteria.description: 批准后对指标、阈值、分析群体或数据规则的任何更改都会进行版本化、合理化和披露，并且原始预先提交的结果仍然是可报告的。
criteria.grader_hint: 方案可以允许必要的修改，但不能允许原始测试消失。

original.criterion: Any change to a metric, threshold, analysis population or data rule after approval is versioned, justified and disclosed, and the original precommitted result remains reportable.
original.grader_hint: The protocol may permit necessary amendments, but must not allow the original test to disappear.

criteria.description: 可信的客户端代码或机密信息边界事件会触发独特的紧急路径，而不是普通的指标审查或丢失数据过程。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求针对潜在严重信息事件的立即遏制或暂停和升级。

original.criterion: A credible client-code or confidential-information boundary event triggers a distinct urgent path rather than the ordinary metric-review or missing-data process.
original.grader_hint: Look for immediate containment or suspension and escalation appropriate to a potentially serious information incident.

criteria.description: 严重异常路径确定谁可以暂停访问、谁进行调查、必须通知谁、如何保存证据以及在重新启动之前需要什么授权。
criteria.grader_hint: 角色头衔或职能是可以接受的；未定义的升级指令则不是。

original.criterion: The severe-exception path identifies who can pause access, who investigates, who must be notified, how evidence is preserved and what authorization is required before any restart.
original.grader_hint: Role titles or functions are acceptable; an undefined instruction to escalate is not.

criteria.description: 常规数据丢失、客户端撤回和严重安全事件具有不同的分类和升级逻辑，因此撤回的遥测源不会自动表示为安全漏洞。
criteria.grader_hint: 信用明确区分证据失效、许可变更和涉嫌边界违规。

original.criterion: Routine data loss, client withdrawal and severe security events have distinct classification and escalation logic, so a withdrawn telemetry feed is not automatically represented as a security breach.
original.grader_hint: Credit clear separation of evidence failure, permission change and suspected boundary violation.

criteria.description: 运营计划为访问控制、入职、数据质量、分析、安全监控、客户协调和季末裁决分配责任所有者和决策日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 每个职能必须有具体的角色和时间安排；在责任明确的情况下，可以对共同贡献者进行分组。

original.criterion: The operating plan assigns accountable owners and decision dates for access control, onboarding, data quality, analysis, security monitoring, client coordination and end-of-quarter adjudication.
original.grader_hint: Each function must have a concrete role and timing; shared contributors may be grouped where accountability remains clear.

criteria.description: 该计划定义了适合开发人员和客户信息的最低数据访问、保留、聚合和报告控制，并且不承诺在链接的操作数据仍然可重新识别的情况下匿名。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找目的限制、基于角色的访问、保留或删除时间以及谨慎的隐私语言。

original.criterion: The plan defines minimum data access, retention, aggregation and reporting controls appropriate to developer and client information and does not promise anonymity where linked operational data remains re-identifiable.
original.grader_hint: Look for purpose limitation, role-based access, retention or deletion timing and careful privacy language.

criteria.description: 预算逻辑可以从规定的变量中重现，包括许可证数量和期限加上材料启用、测量和支持工作，而所有未知的价格或费率仍然标记为输入或假设。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证使用示例假设的算术关系。不需要特定的货币金额。

original.criterion: The budget logic is reproducible from stated variables and includes licence quantity and duration plus material enablement, measurement and support effort, while all unknown prices or rates remain labelled inputs or assumptions.
original.grader_hint: Verify arithmetic relationships where example assumptions are used. Do not require a specific currency amount.

criteria.description: 所有说明性数字都清楚地标记为计划假设、目标或决策变量，并且没有一个工件将捏造的历史结果、客户节省或供应商报价作为事实。
criteria.evidence: 围绕定量内容的标签、脚注和叙述。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查图表和摘要以及预算部分是否有无根据的事实主张。

original.criterion: All illustrative numbers are clearly labelled as planning assumptions, targets or decision variables, and neither artifact presents fabricated historical results, client savings or a vendor quotation as fact.
original.evidence: Labels, footnotes and narrative surrounding quantitative content.
original.grader_hint: Inspect charts and summaries as well as the budget section for unsupported factual claims.

criteria.description: 无论这些数字出现在哪里，这两个工件都使用相同的小队人数、批准日期、试点持续时间和比较期边界。
criteria.evidence: 跨文档范围和时间表数据。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较 DOCX 和 PPTX 中的所有出现情况；如果解析结果相同，则等效的日期规则是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The two artifacts use the same squad count, approval date, pilot duration and comparison-period boundaries wherever those figures appear.
original.grader_hint: Compare all occurrences in the DOCX and PPTX; equivalent date rules are acceptable if they resolve identically.

criteria.description: 简报中显示的主要结果定义和每个决策阈值与备忘录中的受控定义和阈值相匹配。
criteria.evidence: 跨文档指标和阈值内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较名称、单位、分母、方向性和数字阈值，而不仅仅是标签。

original.criterion: The primary outcome definition and every decision threshold shown in the briefing match the controlled definitions and thresholds in the memorandum.
original.grader_hint: Compare names, units, denominators, directionality and numerical thresholds, not merely labels.

criteria.description: 对于相同的假设结果，简报的通过、不通过和不可评估的逻辑产生与备忘录相同的结果，包括边界值和严重事件覆盖。
criteria.grader_hint: 对这两个版本至少应用一个明确的成功案例、一个阈值边界、一个护栏违规案例和一个不可评估案例。

original.criterion: The briefing’s go, no-go and non-evaluable logic produces the same outcome as the memorandum for the same hypothetical result, including boundary values and severe-event overrides.
original.grader_hint: Apply at least one clear success case, one threshold boundary, one guardrail breach and one non-evaluable case to both versions.

criteria.description: 简报中重复的预算变量或说明性假设在计算金额以及许可数量和期限方面与备忘录一致，误差在 ±1% 范围内。
criteria.grader_hint: 尽可能重新计算显示的总计并比较重复的输入。

original.criterion: Budget variables or illustrative assumptions repeated in the briefing agree with the memorandum within ±1% for calculated amounts and exactly for licence counts and durations.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate displayed totals where possible and compare repeated inputs.

criteria.description: 该备忘录足够精确，可以作为受控协议：独立分析师可以确定资格、任务、所需数据、初步分析和决策结果，而无需要求作者发明规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断操作的完整性而不是仅考虑文章的润色；注意任何对决策至关重要的模糊性。

original.criterion: The memorandum is sufficiently precise to serve as the controlled protocol: an independent analyst could determine eligibility, assignment, required data, primary analysis and decision outcome without asking the author to invent a rule.
original.grader_hint: Judge operational completeness rather than prose polish alone; note any decision-critical ambiguity.

criteria.description: 该简报将设计压缩为可供决策的叙述，使合作伙伴可以理解中心权衡、证据标准、重大风险和批准边界，而不与详细协议相矛盾。
criteria.evidence: 完整的简报以及与备忘录的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 相信选择性、准确的合成，而不是每个协议细节的微型副本。

original.criterion: The briefing compresses the design into a decision-ready narrative that makes the central tradeoff, evidence standard, material risks and approval boundaries understandable to partners without contradicting the detailed protocol.
original.evidence: Entire briefing and comparison with memorandum.
original.grader_hint: Credit selective, accurate synthesis rather than a miniature copy of every protocol detail.

criteria.description: 最后一张幻灯片要求批准 12 10 月的具体试点设计、测量规则和权限边界，并且不会以企业推出建议或无主通用后续步骤列表结束。
criteria.grader_hint: 所请求的合作伙伴决定应明确并仅限于试点协议是否适合启动。

original.criterion: The final slide asks for approval of a specific pilot design, measurement rule and authority boundary for 12 October and does not end with an enterprise-rollout recommendation or an unowned generic next-steps list.
original.grader_hint: The requested partner decision should be explicit and limited to whether the pilot protocol is fit to activate.

spec.professional_context: Dalefield Alliance is preparing an enterprise-level, one-quarter controlled pilot of an AI coding assistant across a heterogeneous delivery organisation. Cross-functional partners need a neutral design record and concise briefing before granting approval to activate the pilot.
difficulty_sources: Selecting a defensible comparison unit and allocation strategy for heterogeneous, interacting delivery squads
Defining operational metrics and an uncertainty-aware decision rule before any data exists
Separating tooling effects from staffing, client, project and codebase changes
Designing distinct responses for incomplete evidence and a rare severe confidentiality event
Maintaining exact agreement between a controlled memorandum and a compressed executive briefing

authoring_plan.solver_instance: Create a neutral controlled-pilot protocol and partner briefing before any outcome data exists. The solution must select and defend one feasible design from a range of professionally valid designs rather than recover a hidden literal answer.
authoring_plan.intended_verdict: A passing reference solution uses a credible concurrent comparison, prospectively fixes one primary outcome and an uncertainty-aware decision rule, distinguishes ordinary evidence failure from a severe information-boundary event, and keeps the memorandum and briefing identical on shared facts. It does not recommend rollout or fabricate commercial or historical facts.
imperfections_and_tensions_to_preserve: There are eleven heterogeneous squads, making cluster count and statistical precision genuine constraints.
Seniority, client setting and codebase age vary and can confound a naive comparison.
Prior ad hoc access creates possible baseline contamination that must be reset, documented or incorporated.
Developers and repositories may cross squad boundaries, creating interference and ambiguous attribution.
Licence assignment and actual meaningful use differ.
Staffing, project mix, repository ownership and delivery phase may change during the quarter.
A client can withdraw telemetry permission or a required feed can fail, making the planned procedure non-completable.
A credible disclosure of source code or confidential information outside approved boundaries is rare but severe and requires a distinct urgent path.
gold_relationships: The eligible organisational scope is eleven squads; any treated and comparison subsets together must be traceable to that scope without double-counting.
Approval occurs on 12 October and precedes all treatment activation.
The funded treatment window lasts one quarter; the design must also define a pre-pilot comparison period.
The primary analysis must compare assigned treatment with a concurrent control and account for baseline, rather than using treated pre/post change alone.
The analysis unit and uncertainty treatment must respect the level of assignment and correlated outcomes.
Exactly one primary delivery outcome drives the benefit test; other measures are secondary, diagnostic or guardrails.
The primary outcome threshold is chosen by the solver but must be numeric, unit-bearing, prospective and identical in both files.
At least one quality or client guardrail is numeric, and a defined severe security event can override favourable delivery results.
Decision categories must be exhaustive and mutually exclusive, with a non-evaluable path that does not count missing evidence as benefit.
Any exposure-based analysis is secondary to assignment-based analysis.
Unknown vendor prices, labour rates, client savings and historical metrics remain formulas, variables, ranges or explicitly labelled assumptions.
Any budget total equals licence quantity multiplied by duration and rate, plus separately identified enablement, measurement and support components.
Every repeated count, date, period, metric definition, threshold, assumption and decision rule agrees between the DOCX and PPTX.
required_professional_content: A causal pilot question and estimand.
A justified experimental or comparison unit.
A concurrent allocation or matching design addressing seniority, client and codebase age.
Baseline comparability checks, contamination handling and treatment adherence measurement.
Cluster-aware and repeated-measure analysis with effect sizes and uncertainty.
Prospective handling of ramp-up, missing data, outliers, staffing changes, repository changes, work mix and calendar shocks.
Operational definitions and sources for the primary outcome, quality, flow, client, security, workforce and cost measures.
A metric hierarchy that prevents selective success claims.
A prospective, uncertainty-aware go/no-go/non-evaluable rule with numeric thresholds.
A protocol amendment trail that preserves the originally committed result.
A routine failure-to-complete path and a separate severe confidentiality or source-code incident path.
Named functional ownership for access, data, analysis, security, client coordination and adjudication.
Data minimization, access, retention and reporting controls.
A reproducible budget model without fabricated price or savings facts.
Explicit limitations that prevent overclaiming causation, anonymity, productivity or client value.
must_not_assert: That raw pre/post improvement proves the assistant caused the change.
That balancing on the three named confounds eliminates all confounding.
That more developer events or repository events automatically create more independent sample units.
That licence assignment proves meaningful use.
That self-selected heavy users form an unbiased treatment group.
That lines of code, suggestion acceptance or usage count alone demonstrates productivity.
That internal telemetry alone proves client satisfaction or savings.
That an approved tool cannot create a security or confidentiality incident.
That missing observations are zero outcomes or can be dropped without consequence.
That statistical significance is guaranteed with eleven squads.
That a favourable point estimate is conclusive regardless of uncertainty or guardrail breaches.
That a non-evaluable pilot is evidence for rollout.
That linked operational data is anonymous merely because names are removed.
That vendor prices, client savings, historical performance or pilot results are known.
authoring_plan.space_feasibility: The rubric is achievable within an eight-page controlled memorandum and ten-slide briefing by using concise metric and decision tables, a governance matrix, a compact timeline and a short exception protocol. The briefing may summarize rather than repeat all protocol detail, provided shared definitions and figures remain identical.
authoring_plan.offline_validation: An imagined reference solution can be authored and rendered offline with python-docx and python-pptx, inspected with standard ZIP/XML tools, and converted with LibreOffice for page and slide review. All rubric items can be evaluated from the submitted files without external facts.

original_instruction:
You’re the enterprise technology portfolio manager at Dalefield Alliance, and Maude Waddington needs a decision-ready design for the controlled pilot of the AI coding assistant that has so far been used ad hoc across our eleven delivery squads, including teams working on Marlowe Logistics. Maude will fund one quarter of licences if the partners approve the design at their 12 October meeting, but nothing may be switched on before that approval. The partners are not deciding whether to roll the assistant out enterprise-wide at this meeting; they are deciding whether the proposed pilot can produce evidence they will be able to act on at the end of the quarter. Please prepare `ai_assistant_pilot_memo.docx` and `ai_assistant_pilot_briefing.pptx`, write both files into the top level of the working directory using exactly those filenames, and make sure every figure, date, definition, threshold and decision outcome appearing in both files agrees. The memorandum must be no more than eight pages, and the briefing must be no more than ten slides. Treat the following as the brief: (1) define a pilot that can distinguish a tooling effect from ordinary delivery variation when squads differ in developer seniority, client setting and codebase age, and make clear what is being compared during a pre-pilot period and the funded quarter; (2) state the measurement definitions, evidence sources, analysis basis and fixed go/no-go rule that would be approved before access is enabled, with enough precision that the rule cannot be rewritten after results are seen; (3) cover delivery outcome, quality, security, client impact, workforce experience and cost without turning every available measure into an equal success criterion; (4) show the operating ownership, decision rights, timing and budget logic needed to run the pilot, but do not invent a vendor price, client savings, historical performance or pilot results—we have supplied none, so use formulas, clearly labelled planning assumptions or decision variables where amounts are needed; (5) account for the fact that licence use does not prove meaningful use, that developers and repositories may cross squad boundaries, and that staffing or project mix can change during the quarter; and (6) make the design usable when evidence collection does not proceed as planned.
